This topic is part of the CCEA GCSE Spanish specification.

Context 2: Local, National, International and Global Areas of Interest appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Context 2: Local, National, International and Global Areas of Interest in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The CCEA board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Context 2: Local, National, International and Global Areas of Interest.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
